sections.Profile:
Super Canasta (or Super Hoop) , released by Quetzal Pinball in 2019, is a basketball-themed pinball machine that builds upon the legacy of the Spanish classics Canasta 86 and New Canasta . Designed by Antonio Ortuño and Gustavo Díaz, this modern iteration features three flippers, two ramps, and a unique mini-playfield with player-controlled slingshots that simulate rebounding.

- Manufacturer: Quetzal Pinball
- Years made: 2019
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
